subject.title: feat: add native inline widget support

question: Should OpenClaw accept this capability-URL, isolated-WebView, and exact-gateway-TLS model as the permanent native trust boundary for assistant-authored widgets?
rationale: Automated review can check the implementation and tests, but accepting executable assistant-authored HTML in native clients and defining its long-term trust boundary requires explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept after exact-head gates
options.body: Approve the proposed fail-closed trust model once all required checks pass on the reviewed head.

options.title: Narrow the initial rollout
options.body: Limit native advertisement to selected clients or connection modes until additional security review or production experience supports the full rollout.

recommendation.title: Accept after exact-head gates
recommendation.body: Approve the proposed fail-closed trust model once all required checks pass on the reviewed head.

likelyOwner.reason: The implementation history and review responses make this person the clearest available owner of the cross-platform widget and trust-boundary design.
